records..write: auth != null && auth.uid === $uid && auth.token.email_verified === true && newData.exists()

$id..validate: $id.matches(/^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$/) && newData.hasChildren(['kind','payload','version','deleted','updatedAt']) && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('version').val() === 1) || (data.exists() && newData.child('kind').val() === data.child('kind').val() && ((newData.child('version').val() === data.child('version').val() && newData.child('payload').val() === data.child('payload').val() && newData.child('deleted').val() === data.child('deleted').val() && newData.child('updatedAt').val() === data.child('updatedAt').val()) || newData.child('version').val() === data.child('version').val() + 1)))
